layout.headline: Frequently asked questions
layout.body: Quick answers across team, evaluations, and logistics. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Reach out — we’re happy to help.

items.question: How do tryouts work for the competitive team?
items.answer: We don't run traditional cut-day tryouts. Instead, every new family books a **free water evaluation** with one of our coaches. Your swimmer swims a short set of skills — usually 25s of each stroke they know, a streamline, and a few laps for endurance — and the coach recommends a starting training group with clear next-step goals. Most evaluations take about 20 minutes.

items.question: How many swim meets does my swimmer have to attend?
items.answer: We want your swimmer to compete in as many or as few swim meets as they want. We know that travel and weekend meets can be demanding on both the family and the swimmer so we want to be flexible in this area.

items.question: How does payment work, and what are your fees?
items.answer: Team membership is billed monthly and includes practice time, coaching, and onsite functional strength, plyometrics, and injury-prevention training. There's a **$100 annual placement fee** per swimmer; meet registration and entry fees are billed separately as they come up. There are no mandatory fundraising fees or parent hours. Parent volunteer requirements will be released at a later date. Current pricing for each training group is listed on the **Team** page.

items.question: Where do parents wait during practice?
items.answer: We have a dedicated parent viewing area with seating where you can watch the entire practice. Our private facility has its own entrance and parking, so drop-off and pick-up are simple. During practice we ask parents to stay in the viewing area so coaches can focus on the swimmers in the pool. Free parking on-site.

items.question: What are your safety standards?
items.answer: Our deck practices follow the **Minor Athlete Abuse Prevention Policy (MAAPP)** — including two-coach rules for one-on-one interactions and required reporting protocols. Lifeguard, CPR, and AED certifications are maintained for staff on deck. If you ever have a concern, talk to Coach Robbie directly.

items.question: Where are you located?
items.answer: C26 Aquatics trains out of a year-round indoor pool inside **Bluhawk** in south Overland Park, at **16201 Shawnee Dr, Suite 126, Overland Park, KS 66223**. From this single home we serve families across Johnson County and the surrounding area, including **Leawood, Lenexa, Olathe, Overland Park, Prairie Village, and Shawnee**.

items.question: What ages do you serve?
items.answer:
Our competitive training groups serve swimmers from **ages 5 through 18**, across seven groups:

- **Pre-Competitive** (5–8) and **Novice Age Group** (7–12) for developing swimmers.
- **Advanced Age Group** (9–14), **Junior Olympic** (9–14), and **Pre-Senior** (11–14) for competitive age-groupers.
- **High School Prep** (14–18) and **Senior Elite** (13–18) for the highest levels of the sport.

If you're not sure where your swimmer fits, we'll evaluate them in the water and recommend the right group.

items.question: Can swimming help kids with anxiety or ADHD?
items.answer: Many families find it does. Research shows regular exercise can improve attention, emotional regulation, and anxiety in kids — and swimming's rhythmic breathing, structure, and measurable progress make it especially well suited. It's not a substitute for professional care, but it can be a powerful complement. Read more about [swimming and well-being](/our-approach/#well-being) on our Approach page.

items.question: How do I sign up?
items.answer:
Use the **Join the Team** button anywhere on the site to request a team evaluation and get started. New families begin with an evaluation so our coaches can place your swimmer in the right training group — reach out if you'd prefer to talk through options first. Team evaluations for the coming season run **August 22–26**.

[Join the Team](https://momence.com/C26-Hub-LLC/product/Swim-Team-Evaluation-and-Placement-Fee%3A-%24100.00/500138)
